scope.authority: Incumbent common-project workbench; scoped extension. Root PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md retain their older photo-library/lightbox scope.
scope.discovery: Scoped companion record at the assigned path; not a replacement for .impeccable/design.json or a claim that the skill's Markdown surface-brief loader discovers this JSON.

focus.name: workbench-keyboard-focus
focus.purpose: Visible focus for workbench controls and the capture opener.

elevation.name: inspector-backdrop
elevation.purpose: Dim the underlying project during local modal inspection; no added decorative shadow.

interaction.inspection: Native modal dialog opens at actual PNG size; Fit, Actual size and Zoom 2× resize the retained image inside a keyboard-focusable scroll region. Close or Escape returns focus to the connected opener.
interaction.offState: Import, retention, download and inspection work with both destination modules off. Each native-copy button requires its own module to be on and is disabled while busy.
interaction.copyTruth: Vector and Layers documents use the retained raster. Complete semantic diagram source stays with the capture; these actions do not reconstruct editable diagram objects or structural layers.
interaction.origin: Optional stored HTTP(S) origin is an explicit link; importing and inspecting do not fetch it.

evidence.provenance: Author-supplied QA captures of synthetic projects and a retained test diagram; inspected by the documenter. No new shipping raster asset was created or copied.
evidence.limit: The documenter read receipts and inspected supplied captures; no app starts or repeated test execution. Verdict covers the added figure flow, not every inherited surface.

narrative.overview: This Operate surface keeps a retained diagram capture beside the project's existing Photos and Vector results. The addition follows the current workbench, including its teal/charcoal and light themes, Cinzel headings, Source Sans 3 controls and native form elements. It does not establish a replacement visual world.
keyCharacteristics: Retained image, complete diagram source and capture identity stay together.
Inspection works locally while both destination modules are off.
Vector and Layers copies explicitly use the retained raster image.
Existing module controls, project navigation and transfer forms remain available.

rules.name: The Source Theme Rule
rules.body: Extend the workbench's theme variables and native controls; preserve the retained image's pixels.

rules.name: The Retained Capture Rule
rules.body: Keep the exact PNG and complete diagram source together; older captures remain available when a different revision or selection is imported.

rules.name: The Explicit Copy Rule
rules.body: Describe these actions as copies using the image; do not imply reconstruction of the diagram's editable semantic objects or structural layers.

dos: **Do** keep capture identity, source download, inspection and explicit copy actions together.
**Do** allow retained import, download, reopening and inspection while destination modules remain off.
**Do** preserve both themes, the wrapping action row and the inspector's local scroll region.
**Do** preserve the complete Photos/Vector clients and the existing project and transfer functions.
donts: **Don't** present raster copies as semantic diagram reconstruction.
**Don't** fetch the origin or activate a destination as a side effect of importing or inspecting a capture.
**Don't** turn the scoped finish verdict into certification of every inherited surface or native editor.
